c99beb48: If the user presses Enter without entering a value, do not enable certain behaviors.
26323fcc: If the user enters a '?' to request help, go to the question mark help routine.
4782c9fd: If the user enters '@' to delete the entire value, go to the delete value routine.
9dffcf3c: If the user enters a space and there is a default value stored, use that default value. But do not display the default value if it is not allowed by the data validation.

168bda44: If there is a list of selectable values, find the one that matches the user input and select it. If the 'S' code is present, execute it. If a match is found, display the value and go to the next field. Otherwise, continue searching the list.
955d8c74: If no match is found in the list, but a partial match exists, display the partial match.
355f555a: Remove the partial match and set the user input to the remaining part of the entry.
594350d3: If the field expects a pointer value, set up the pointer lookup routine and execute it. If a valid value is returned, use it. Otherwise, go to the next field.
83b8f819: If the field expects a numeric value and the user input is not a valid number, reset the value and go to the help routine.

3c11bf38: If the field expects a numeric value and the user input contains a decimal point, remove any leading or trailing zeros from the fractional part. If the fractional part is empty, convert the value to an integer.
0a4ce97f: Execute any code associated with the current field.
c000bad9: If a value was entered, store it in the global array and, if the field is a date field, store the default value in the user's personal global.
80293f67: If the user input is invalid, display a '??' error message and go to the help routine.
4ab29f98: Set the value to a special code indicating an invalid input.
e54c79dc: If the user requested help by entering a '?', execute the help routine and go back to the field.
